title: Admin/Supplier 视频清理持久恢复、分页租约与实际 PG16 验证

implemented: 五分钟Cron分别投递Admin和Supplier固定scope根消息；分钟自动上下架保留
持久两行游标、UUID固定高水位、每页80条先取窗口再判终态或实际到期，120秒租约及300秒完成周期节流
claim/bind/Queue/ACK分离，所有SQL终态CAS+精确回读，不跨Queue I/O持有SQL事务；接受结果不明允许重复而不跳过
从持久上传事实重新派发原有严格UUID清理消费者，全部旧消息或续页丢失由下一Cron恢复；每周期重访长期终态以收敛迟到写入
缺失/漂移addon、权限或素材name索引均停止派发；Admin和Supplier独立就绪
严格两字段普通Queue和DLQ协议，不接受caller cursor/key/lease/tenant/cutoff
unchanged: 原0185/0186上传合同及目录摘要
HTTP路由、前端、统计接口及用户选择保留的PHP兼容行为
既有逐上传cleanup仍是唯一R2删除授权路径：持久owner事实+真实附件表fence+所有owner对象名引用检查

0188.runtime: read-only exact catalog proof plus SELECT name LIMIT0; no install/repair

migrations.rollout: Both addons require explicit PG16 owner maintenance transactions and reviewed runtime grants. Install the attachment lookup index and GC state before enabling the new runtime. The requested upload scope must be installed; the other scope can be absent. No production DDL/deploy performed.

limits: Local stand-ins do not prove production Cloudflare fault timing or provider integration.

The new index is proven at dispatch admission; DDL after a transaction releases its lock remains an external catalog change. Existing per-upload cleanup keeps its own bounded statement/lock errors and reference checks.
Periodic GC covers durable 0185/0186 roots, not old objects with no durable upload owner record.
The completed-cycle throttle is real DB wall time; future cron delivery is required for liveness.
The complete PHP-to-TS migration, full new-head cloud CI and production acceptance remain open.
